While definitive confirmation would require calprotectin or endoscopy, the preponderance of negative findings — no symptoms, no EIMs, no surgical history, stable on effective therapy — makes active disease unlikely. Per diagnostic parsimony (Occam’s razor), the single most likely diagnosis at this stage is not a new condition, but the current status: **Crohn disease in remission**.
